card.name: Copies after viral load numbers
card.fires_on: The word "copies" right after a viral load number, such as HIV-1 RNA less than 50 or HBV DNA above 1000, before "per mL" or "/mL".

modes.label: HIV RNA threshold
modes.description: Copies after a number in a virologically suppressed HIV-1 RNA statement.
modes.example: virologically suppressed (HIV-1 RNA less than 50<< copies>> per mL), one tablet taken once daily

modes.label: HBV DNA level
modes.description: Copies after a number in hepatitis B DNA level statements.
modes.example: serum HBV DNA remains above 1000<< copies>>/mL with continued treatment

card.plain: It marks the unit "copies" that follows a virus level number in HIV or hepatitis B text.
